minor.issue: SSE stream consistently truncated at 60s by ingress/proxy for LLM calls in the ~55-65s window (revise turn in this iteration). status=200, event:done fires but data payload never arrives; LiteLLM logs confirm the LLM completed each retry. Not a defect in the M14 reasoner or engine; the writing turn (~48s) completes cleanly through SSE. Consider (a) longer proxy timeout for /api/sessions/*/interact, or (b) sending the done payload earlier by parallelizing the DB update with the SSE yield, or (c) chunked incremental theory streaming.

Nothing else can be taught until a position exists. Proportional.' — anti pile-on discipline confirmed on a weak draft. server.py — DB persistence (line 874 db.sessions.update_one) happens BEFORE the SSE 'event: done' yield (line 885). Even if the client-side SSE frame is truncated by an ingress timeout, the DB should reflect the updated state. Empirical observation: after the revise turn failed with 60s cutoff, GET /api/sessions/{id} showed the session STILL at 2 turns (writing + ai only), meaning the update_one never fired — which further confirms the LLM chat streaming inside the reasoner is being cancelled when the client disconnects at 60s (the async generator is torn down before reaching _apply_engine_result). Consider decoupling the reasoner run from the SSE stream (fire-and-forget the reasoner + persistence, let clients poll for completion) so that ingress timeouts do not lose the completed LLM work.

rca of the issue: No M14 defect. The revise-turn 60s SSE cutoff RCA: (1) Reproduced with raw curl on the same session — the SSE stream emitted only ': tick' heartbeats for exactly 60.0s then the connection closed with no event:done and no data. File size 1136 bytes = ~136 tick lines at 2 ticks/s heartbeat. (2) Backend LiteLLM logs show the completion() call fired on each of 3 pytest retry attempts and 1 curl attempt, and each completed at ~55-65s of LLM time (14:24:56, 14:25:51, 14:26:55, 14:27:59 in the log). No error/exception logged. (3) GET /api/sessions/{sid} AFTER the failed revise turn shows the session STILL at 2 turns (writing + ai only, no revise turn persisted) — this means db.sessions.update_one (server.py L874) NEVER FIRED for the revise turn even though the LLM completed. The only way this happens: the async event_generator was cancelled by the client disconnect at 60s BEFORE reaching L874 — the async LlmChat.send_message_stream is awaited inside the generator, and when the SSE consumer closes at 60s Starlette cancels the generator task, which propagates as asyncio.CancelledError up the LLM stream. (4) Fix at infrastructure level: raise the ingress SSE idle timeout (or total request timeout) to >=120s for /api/sessions/*/interact so LLM calls in the 55-65s window can finish and yield the done frame. Alternate fix at server level: run the reasoner in a background task, persist immediately on completion, and have the SSE stream just tail the DB record (a client that disconnects doesn't lose the reasoner output). Neither is required for M14 acceptance — the 30/30 eval already covered all revise scenarios and the writing-turn acceptance held cleanly.
